subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given below to fill in the blank in the following sentence.**

Static

Society is not a/an ______ but a dynamic entity.
solution:
The correct answer is: **inert**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Static **means lacking in movement, action, or change. (स्थिर)

 
 
• **Example**: *The radio station experienced static on the frequency, causing interference with the broadcast.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Inert **means lacking the ability or strength to move or act. (निष्क्रिय)
 
 
• **Example**: *The chemicals remained inert until the right conditions activated their reactive properties in the laboratory experiment.*
 
 
 
• **Complete sentence**: Society is not an inert __but a dynamic entity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Independent**" means having the ability to function or operate on its own, without relying on external control or support. (स्वतंत्र)
 
• "**Capable**" refers to having the ability, skills, or qualities necessary to achieve or perform a particular task. (काबिल)
 
• "**Variable**" is something that is subject to change or variation, often in quantity, value, or nature. (परिवर्तनीय)
